{{Quote|&hellip;during the Great Shadow Crusade, the image of the massive ''[mythosaur]'' skull was the sigil of Clan Keldau, famed for its combat trainers.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
'''Clan Keldau''' was an ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Crusades]]. Clan Keldau earned great renown in Mandalorian culture for the many [[Instructor/Legends|combat trainers]] that emerged from its ranks, and bore the iconic symbol of a [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]] [[Skeleton/Legends|skull]] as its identifying clan sigil. As time passed, Clan Keldau eventually [[Death/Legends|died]] out, but the famed Mandalorian clan was remembered long after its demise; [[Tor Vizsla]], founder and leader of the radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], noted Clan Keldau's place in Mandalorian history in his manifesto, ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]''.<ref name="TBHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Keldau was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2013]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] reference guide, ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Ryder Windham]].
